content:
The image shows a mango leaf that is completely dried out and brown, curled/rolled inward along its length, with no green tissue remaining. This is a completely desiccated, dead leaf.

**Key observations:**
- Entire leaf is uniformly brown/tan — complete necrosis
- Leaf is curled and shriveled lengthwise
- No powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- No black sooty layer (rules out Sooty Mould)
- No discrete dark lesions with defined margins (less consistent with Anthracnose)
- The pattern — complete shoot/leaf death with browning from tip — matches Die Back, where the terminal shoot dies and leaves dessicate completely

Die Back causes progressive death from shoot tips downward, resulting in completely brown, shriveled leaves that remain attached to the branch, which matches this image well.
